disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly defrauding, abusing, or aiding in the defrauding or abusing of the workers' compensation system.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspend, revoke, or deny a license of a person who the board determines, after a hearing as provided in subsection (1)(b), is guilty of knowingly defrauding, abusing, or aiding in the defrauding or abusing of the workers' compensation system

disciplinary_grounds.description: Returning to use of a prohibited substance on three separate occasions while in a medical assistance program.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: take disciplinary action against the license of a person in a medical assistance program under chapter 3, 4, 7, or 8 if, in the period under contract, the licensee has on three separate occasions returned to the use of a prohibited or proscribed substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish required information about legal or disciplinary actions, or filing false information on an application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the required information, except pursuant to 37-1-138, or the filing of false information is grounds for denial or revocation of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding of unprofessional conduct by an applicant or license holder, impose a sanction provided by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing a written prescription that cannot be read by a licensed pharmacist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A medical practitioner may not issue a written prescription, to be delivered to a patient or pharmacy, in such a manner that the name of the drug, the dosage, the instructions for use... cannot be read by a registered pharmacist
disciplinary_grounds.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 2. General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practi] 37-2-107

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing a sensitive medical examination on an anesthetized or unconscious patient without specific informed consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of subsection (1) constitutes unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 2. General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practi] 37-2-306

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adhere to 50-4-1004 regarding medical or surgical transition for minors constitutes unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a health care professional, mental health professional, or physician to adhere to 50-4-1004 constitutes unprofessional conduct, with a mandatory minimum suspension of the ability to practice the person's profession for 1 year.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 2. General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practi] 37-2-307

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the performance of services requiring substantial specialized knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological, and sociological sciences and of nursing theory as a basis for the nursing process.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance of services requiring substantial specialized knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological, and sociological sciences and of nursing theory as a basis for the nursing process.

methods_authorized.quote: The nursing process is the assessment, nursing analysis, planning, nursing intervention, and evaluation in the promotion and maintenance of health, the prevention, casefinding, and management of illness, injury, or infirmity, and the restoration of optimum function. The term also includes administration, teaching, counseling, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice and the administration of medications and treatments

drug_authority.value: RNs may administer medications and treatments prescribed by physicians, naturopathic physicians, physician assistants, optometrists, advanced practice registered nurses, dentists, osteopaths, or podiatrists. APRNs may be granted prescriptive authority by the board.
drug_authority.quote: adopt rules regarding authorization for prescriptive authority of advanced practice registered nurses. If considered appropriate for an advanced practice registered nurse who applies to the board for authorization, prescriptive authority must be granted.

license_tiers.quote: a person practicing or offering to practice: (1) professional nursing in this state shall submit evidence that the person is qualified to practice and is licensed as provided in this chapter; (2) practical nursing in this state shall submit evidence that the person is qualified to practice and is licensed as provided in this chapter; (3) as a medication aide in this state shall submit evidence that the person is qualified to practice and is licensed as provided in this chapter.

aprn_role_categories.quote: Advanced practice registered nurses include nurse practitioners, nurse-midwives, nurse anesthetists, and clinical nurse specialists.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: These services are performed under the supervision of a registered nurse or a physician, naturopathic physician, physician assistant, optometrist, dentist, osteopath, or podiatrist authorized by state law to prescribe medications and treatments.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: A person licensed under this chapter who holds a certificate in a field of advanced practice registered nursing may practice in the specified field of advanced practice registered nursing upon approval by the board of an amendment to the person's license granting a certificate in a field of advanced practice registered nursing.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: When an APRN authorized to prescribe an opioid prescribes to an opioid-naive patient on an outpatient basis, the prescription may not be for more than a 7-day supply (with exceptions for chronic pain, cancer, palliative care, or opioid treatment drugs). Note: This provision terminates June 30, 2025.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: when a medical practitioner or a naturopathic physician authorized to prescribe an opioid prescribes an opioid to an opioid-naive patient on an outpatient basis, the prescription may not be for more than a 7-day supply.
opioid_prescribing_limits.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 2. General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practi] 37-2-108

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: a person practicing or offering to practice as a medication aide in this state shall submit evidence that the person is qualified to practice and is licensed as provided in this chapter.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: nursing tasks delegated by licensed nurses to unlicensed persons according to rules adopted by the board

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all jurisdictions legally joining in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: establish a medical assistance program to assist licensees who are found to be physically or mentally impaired by habitual intemperance or the excessive use of addictive drugs, alcohol, or any other drug or substance or by mental illness or chronic physical illness.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A licensed health care provider may provide services by means of telehealth when appropriate, meets the standard of care, and complies with board rules. Telehealth includes audio, video, or other telecommunications technology over a secure connection compliant with state and federal privacy laws.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person licensed under this title to provide health care in the ordinary course of business or practice of a profession may provide services by means of telehealth when the use of telehealth: (a) is appropriate for the services being provided; (b) meets the standard of care for delivery of services; and (c) complies with any administrative rules for telehealth adopted by the board that licenses the health care provider.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 2. General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practi] 37-2-305

military_education_credit_required.quote: Each board and program shall, upon presentation of satisfactory evidence by an applicant for certification or licensure, accept relevant education, training, or service completed in the armed forces or reserves of the United States or the national guard, military reserves, or naval militia of a state toward the qualifications to receive the license or certification.
